source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 199 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 199 was established by Ordinance No. 18683, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 24, 1985. Ordinance No. 18683 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 18683 was amended by Ordinance No. 21693, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 9, 1993. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18683; 21693; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 199 is established on property generally fronting on the south line of Willow Lane, beginning at a point approximately 175 feet west of the west line of Browning Lane. The size of PD 199 is approximately 4.9 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-199.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development must be in accordance with the development plan (Exhibit 199A). (Ord. Nos. 18683; 21693; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.105.USES. The only main uses permitted on the Property are single-family uses and a private street. All single-family dwelling units must be detached. (Ord. Nos. 21693; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.106.LANDSCAPING. Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 199B). All plant material must be maintained in a health growing condition at all times by the homeowners’ association which must be established to maintain all common areas. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.107.DENSITY. Development is limited to a maximum of 19 dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.108.HEIGHT. Maximum permitted height for all buildings and structures is 30 feet. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.109.COVERAGE. Maximum permitted coverage for each lot is 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.110.SETBACKS. Minimum setbacks for all buildings and structures are those shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.111.PAVING. All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must comply with the requirements of Division 51-4.300, “Off-Street Parking and Loading Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)

sections.title: Private Street
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.112.PRIVATE STREET. The private street shown on the development plan must be constructed and maintained in compliance with Section 51A-8.604(d) of Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 21693; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.113.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business districts contained in Division 51- 7.400. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-199.114.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Development of this Property must comply with all codes and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-199.115.ZONING MAP. PD 199 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. Nos. 18683; 25508)
